drivingQuestion: After which foods are the three blessings of Grace after Meals recited, and what blessing is said over water drunk for thirst?
outcomeNote: A mishna recording two tannaitic disputes — Rabban Gamliel against the Sages (with R' Akiva extending the three blessings further still), and the anonymous first view against R' Tarfon on the blessing over water. Nothing is decided within the unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אָכַל עֲנָבִים וּתְאֵנִים וְרִמּוֹנִים — מְבָרֵךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם שָׁלֹשׁ בְּרָכוֹת, דִּבְרֵי רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: בְּרָכָה אַחַת מֵעֵין שָׁלֹשׁ. רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: אֲפִילּוּ אָכַל שֶׁלֶק וְהוּא מְזוֹנוֹ — מְבָרֵךְ עָלָיו שָׁלֹשׁ בְּרָכוֹת. הַשּׁוֹתֶה מַיִם לִצְמָאוֹ — מְבָרֵךְ ״שֶׁהַכֹּל נִהְיָה בִּדְבָרוֹ״. רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן אוֹמֵר: ״בּוֹרֵא נְפָשׁוֹת רַבּוֹת וְחֶסְרוֹנָן״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who ate» from the fruit for which Eretz Yisrael was praised, «grapes and figs and pomegranates, recites» the «three blessings» of Grace after Meals, as he would after eating bread; this is «the statement of Rabban Gamliel. And the Rabbis say:» One need only recite «one blessing abridged from» the «three» blessings of Grace after Meals. «Rabbi Akiva says:» The three blessings of Grace after Meals are not restricted to bread; rather, «even» if «one ate boiled vegetables, but it is his» primary «sustenance, he recites» the «three blessings» of Grace after Meals. Additionally: «One who drinks water» to quench «his thirst recites: By whose word all things came to be. Rabbi Tarfon says:» He recites: «Who creates the many forms of life and their needs.»

moves.summary: Rabban Gamliel: the three blessings of Grace are recited after the fruits of the seven species
moves.about: whether one who eats grapes, figs or pomegranates recites the full three blessings of Grace after Meals or only a single blessing abridged from three

moves.cueHe: וחכמים אומרים: ברכה אחת מעין שלש
moves.summary: the Sages: only one blessing abridged from three
moves.about: how far the three blessings of Grace after Meals extend beyond bread — whether they are recited over any food that is a person's sustenance, even boiled vegetables

moves.summary: R' Akiva: even boiled vegetables, if they are one's sustenance, take the three blessings
moves.about: which blessing is recited over water drunk to quench thirst — שהכל נהיה בדברו or בורא נפשות רבות וחסרונן

moves.summary: one who drinks water for thirst recites שהכל נהיה בדברו
R' Tarfon: he recites בורא נפשות רבות וחסרונן
